svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make 4: two per capstan. Left frames also get the pawl boss.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cheek: 6 mm plate, 660 wide at the base, 220 at the top, 860 tall;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: base edge 40 mm up (it sits on the runner).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ear at the rear: 70 mm tall, round end R35, 22 mm hole 230 behind

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the drum centre line and 650 mm above the ground.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drum hole 60 mm at 560 mm up; crank shaft hole 40 mm at 756 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bearing bolts: 14 mm holes on a 102 square (drum), 12 mm on a 70

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: square (crank shaft), centred on each hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cross tube bolts: 11 mm pairs 50 apart at the three tube positions.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pawl bolt 25 mm at 130 back, 690 up; brake pivot 21 mm at 200 back,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 330 up. Drill both in all four frames.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Runner: SHS 40 x 40 x 3, 900 long, 400 ahead of and 500 behind the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drum centre. Weld the cheek on its centre line, both sides.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Left frames: weld a 40 OD, 24 bore boss 52 long on the outside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: over the pawl hole. Galvanise after welding and drilling.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the drum and crank shaft holes of a pair line up on a rod.
